configurations.name: CoachApp
runtimeArgs: & { $root = (Get-Location).Path; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'index.html'))) { Write-Error ('No index.html under ' + $root + ' -- refusing to serve a directory that is not a CoachApp checkout.'); exit 1 }; $bs = [string][char]92; $rootFull = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($root).TrimEnd([char]92) + $bs; $allowed = @('.html','.css','.js','.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.gif','.svg','.ico','.webp','.woff','.woff2','.map','.txt'); $l = New-Object System.Net.HttpListener; $l.Prefixes.Add('http://localhost:3001/'); $l.Start(); Write-Host ('Listening on http://localhost:3001 serving ' + $root); while ($l.IsListening) { try { $ctx = $l.GetContext(); $req = $ctx.Request; $res = $ctx.Response; if (-not [System.Net.IPAddress]::IsLoopback($req.RemoteEndPoint.Address)) { $res.StatusCode = 403; $res.ContentLength64 = 0; $res.OutputStream.Close(); continue }; $path = $req.Url.LocalPath.TrimStart('/'); if ($path -eq '' -or $path -eq '/') { $path = 'index.html' }; $ok = $true; foreach ($seg in ($path.Replace($bs, '/') -split '/')) { if ($seg.StartsWith('.') -or $seg -match '~[0-9]') { $ok = $false } }; $full = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $root $path)); $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($full).ToLower(); if (-not $full.StartsWith($rootFull, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or ($allowed -notcontains $ext)) { $ok = $false }; if ($ok -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $full -PathType Leaf)) { $mime = if ($ext -eq '.css') { 'text/css' } elseif ($ext -eq '.js') { 'application/javascript' } elseif ($ext -eq '.html') { 'text/html' } else { 'application/octet-stream' }; $res.ContentType = $mime; $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($full); $res.ContentLength64 = [long]$bytes.Length; $res.OutputStream.Write($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length) } else { $res.StatusCode = 404; $res.ContentLength64 = 0 }; $res.OutputStream.Close() } catch { try { $res.StatusCode = 500; $res.ContentLength64 = 0; $res.OutputStream.Close() } catch { } } } }
